response.sql: SELECT c.customer_id, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count, COUNT(o.order_id) * 1.0 / NULLIF(t.total_orders, 0) AS order_share FROM Customers AS c LEFT JOIN Orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id CROSS JOIN (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_orders FROM Orders) AS t GROUP BY c.customer_id, t.total_orders ORDER BY order_share DESC NULLS LAST, c.customer_id LIMIT 10;
